text:
Felipe (Finance): Noticed INV-2298 for customer NovaLabs includes a $4,450 burst charge that the account team says was caused by our autoscaler misrouting during a zone maintenance window. Please confirm.

Dana (Billing): Pulling invoice lines now.

Cam (Acct Mgmt): Customer provided logs showing dedicated jobs failedover to hosted pool on 2026-06-12 22:10 UTC; they expect we remove the burst fees.

billing-bot: Invoice INV-2298 generated on 2026-06-15. Total: $12,720. Burst: $4,450.

Rene (Platform): I dug into scheduler traces: maintenance window in us-west-1 triggered rehome and some job restarts were double-instrumented by the metrics agent. We created duplicate meter events for ~3.2k GPU-min. INF-1405 open.

Felipe (Finance): If double-metering is our fault we should issue credit. What's the proposed workflow?

Dana (Billing): Proposal: 1) create credit memo CM-501 for full burst amount $4,450; 2) hold collection for INV-2298; 3) attach INF-1405 evidence and job_id dedupe extract.

Cam (Acct Mgmt): Customer prefers refund to cash, not credit. Their payments department is strict. Cash refund >$2k needs finance sign-off.

Felipe (Finance): I can approve up to $5k cash refund for proven platform errors. Dana, draft refund memo and route to payments. Cam, please coordinate customer banking details once approved.

Rene (Platform): I'll attach the deduped meter export to BLG-960 and mark which events are platform duplicates. Estimated impact matches $4.45k burst.

Dana (Billing): Created BLG-960: "novalabs-inv2298-meter-duplication" and CM-501 draft. Holding collection.

billing-bot: BLG-960 created and linked to INV-2298.

Cam (Acct Mgmt): I'll update customer: "We're investigating and will refund if platform duplication confirmed. No charges will be collected during review."

Felipe (Finance): Action items: Rene attach deduped export by EOD, Dana finalize refund memo, Cam collect customer payout info after approvals. Target resolution 2026-06-18.

Dana (Billing): Noted. Will post final status here once payments processes refund.
